title: toy_11826836_11826992
text: >>11826970 Looks like a masterpiece compared to some of the shit he's released in the Spawn line. Looks like the pieces are probably given a wash unassembled, and then put together. Either some pieces got a heavier wash, or they weren't able to match colors or something. Still isn't even close to the worst things he's released in this line. I'd rather have mismatched washes, than shitty, bare plastic that look like preschooler toys.
